subject: Post-call: usage profile & target $/1M - Novapower
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@novapower.com>
Cc: Nathan Li <nathan.li@novapower.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: usage profile & target $/1M - Novapower

Alex — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a small data ask so we can lock in a realistic pricing ballpark ahead of the quoting call: 

Recap (1-2 lines):
- You’re building an AI assistant for customer ops (triage + suggested replies + routing) with multi-turn context. Expect to replace some internal macros and augment support agents.

Data we need to finalize a pricing estimate: could you confirm the following by EOD tomorrow? short bullets fine.
- Monthly token volume (approx): active users * avg sessions per user * tokens per session is fine.
- Average prompt tokens per request (examples appreciated).
- Average completion tokens per response.
- Percent of requests that need >8k context, >32k, and >128k (rough percentages).
- Peak QPS or concurrent sessions at peak.
- Any strict data residency / on-prem requirements or SOC2/HIPAA constraints.
- Target unit cost (your expected $/1M tokens) or target monthly spend range.

I’m attaching a short usage template + our one-pager pricing brief to make this easier; I can run a few scenarios once you send the numbers and share a quick ballpark before the next demo. Proposed next step: 30-min follow-up Wed or Thu to review the scenarios.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | (415) 555-0173
[Attachment: usage-profile-template.csv] [Attachment: redwood-pricing-quicksheet.pdf]

From: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@novapower.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Nathan Li <nathan.li@novapower.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: usage profile & target $/1M - Novapower

Monica — thanks, and appreciate the template. Quick answers below (high level, we can follow up with exact exports):

- Monthly token volume: ~45M tokens/month (we're early, but ramp expected 2–3x over 6–9 months depending on rollout).
- Avg prompt tokens: ~180 tokens (typical user prompt is 1–3 short messages + metadata).
- Avg completion tokens: ~320 tokens (we trim for conciseness, on average about 200–500).
- Context distribution: ~85% of requests stay within an 8k window, ~12% need 32k, ~3% are rare long-history threads that could hit 128k.
- Peak: ~35 concurrent sessions during peak hours, about 5–6 QPS sustained at peak bursts (short spikes up to ~12 QPS).
- Compliance: SOC2 required; no on-prem for GA but if needed in future we may explore Private deployment.
- Target unit cost: we’re hoping for something in the range of $700–$900 per 1M tokens to meet our budget; total monthly budget for this phase is roughly $30k–$45k.

Happy to jump on the 30-min follow-up Wed afternoon — available 1–4pm PT.

—Alex Byrne
Head of AI Product, Novapower
alex.byrne@novapower.com | +1 212-555-0119

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@novapower.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 18:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: usage profile & target $/1M - Novapower

Alex — perfect, this is exactly what we need. A couple quick clarifying Qs before the scenarios:
- The 45M tokens — is that inclusive of both prompts + completions, correct? (we’ll model unit economics on total tokens).
- For the 12% at 32k: is that evenly distributed across sessions or concentrated in a small set of power users? That matters for batching/caching estimates.
- Do the 128k cases include long transcript history + attachments or are they mostly long text-only threads?

Plan: I’ll run three scenario models (hosted, dedicated reserved, and dedicated + KV cache) and map to your $700–$900/M target. Karthik — can you pencil a quick estimate for an 8k-first model vs mixed-window profile? Marissa — flag any immediate compliance or SLA notes if this looks like an enterprise pilot.

Action items I've attached (usage template + one-pager) — if you can fill the CSV with a week of raw traffic (even a sample) we can flip more accurate numbers quickly. Wed 2pm PT works for us, can you confirm?

Thanks —
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage-profile-template.csv]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: usage profile & target $/1M - Novapower

FYI — forwarding Alex's replies from last night. TL;DR: 45M tokens/mo (prompts+completions), avg prompt ~180, avg completion ~320, 85/12/3 split for 8k/32k/128k. Target $700–$900 per 1M tokens, SOC2 required, peak ~5–6 QPS.

Karthik — could you run a quick back-of-envelope comparing:
1) hosted pricing w/ smart caching (assume 45M tokens) at our standard hosted unit + volume discounts — what $/1M do we need to hit $700 target?
2) dedicated reserved GPU (monthly commit) estimate and the effective $/1M for 45M tokens + potential 2x ramp; include capex for 32k/128k windows where batch sizes drop.
3) any obvious savings from prefix/KV caching for this mix (we should show savings if 85% stay within 8k).

Marissa — call out compliance/SLA guidance (SOC2 + any additional evidence they'd need for an enterprise pilot).

Plan to have a 20–30m internal calc sync in 3 hours, then I’ll take the ball to Alex on the pricing call at 2pm PT.

—Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
